brand.voice: Quiet, exact and unhurried. Short sentences and plain words. Sampéa says only what it knows: the bottle, 30 ml, 40% perfume oil, not yet launched. It never fills a gap with a claim.

pages.heading: Privacy policy

sections.headline: Privacy policy
sections.intro: This policy explains how Sampéa uses the personal details you give us through this website.

blocks.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: We collect only what you choose to give us: your email address when you join the launch list, what you include when you write to contact@houseofsampea.com, and the details needed to complete an order once we start selling.

blocks.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your email address to tell you about Sampéa's launch and to reply when you write to us. We use order details to process, deliver and support your order. We don't sell your personal details.

blocks.heading: Who else handles it
paragraphs: This website and shop run on the Tyashin platform, which stores this information on our behalf. Payment details at checkout are handled by the payment provider, not kept by us.

blocks.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask to see, correct or delete the details we hold about you, or leave the launch list, by writing to contact@houseofsampea.com.

blocks.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we change this policy, the updated version will appear on this page.

pages.heading: Terms of use

sections.headline: Terms of use
sections.intro: These terms apply when you use the Sampéa website and shop. By using the site, you agree to them.

blocks.heading: Before launch
paragraphs: Sampéa has not launched. Products shown on this site can't be bought yet, and scent names, notes, prices and the launch date aren't public. Joining the launch list doesn't reserve a product or commit you to buying one.

blocks.heading: Orders
paragraphs: When sales open, prices and order terms will be shown in the shop and at checkout before you pay.

blocks.heading: Our content
paragraphs: The text, images, the SAMPÉA wordmark and the lotus on this site belong to Sampéa. Please don't copy or reuse them without our permission.

blocks.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms. The current version is always the one on this page.

blocks.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these terms can be sent to contact@houseofsampea.com.
